messages:
Priya S: Quick heads-up — PR #1247 updates the SDK example for batching + KV-prefetch but the quant profile link points to the old `qprofile-v1` and the snippet still uses `float32`. We should either update the link to the v2 profiles or call out dtype explicitly in the sample.

Marco L: Oof, saw that. I started a tiny follow-up on the branch but held off pushing. Which approach do we want? swap the link to qprofile-v2 or show both snippets (fp32 + int8)?

Ana K: For the migration guide I prefer showing fp32 -> int8 example so customers can see delta, but in the SDK quickstart we should keep simplest single example. Maybe update the docs quickstart to reference the migration guide for the int8 path.

Priya S: Agreed. Proposed plan: 1) update quickstart snippet to explicitly set `dtype: float32` and change the profile link to `qprofile-v2` (public alias), 2) add a short section in migration guide with both snippets and a note about quality vs cost tradeoff.

Marco L: I'll update the quickstart PR accordingly. Quick patch I was going to push: change the link and add a one-liner comment about dtype. Pushing in ~10m.

Priya S: Thanks — can you also drop a changelog entry in the PR description so release notes pick it up? ticket: DOCS-587.

Marco L: Yep. Also found one failing unit test in docs CI referencing the old sample path, will fix.

docs-bot: PR #1247 — check run started (docs-ci). 2 checks queued.

Jay O: Re: migration guide wording, add an explicit callout about KV-prefetch behavior with quantized models (small prompt prefixes may get clipped if block size changes). I can draft a short blurb.

Ana K: Good call — customer support has seen two queries about short-prefix truncation when switching to 8-bit. We should include a small diagnostic snippet to check prefix retention.

Priya S: Can we include the diagnostic as a tiny curl + API snippet? Something like: 
```
# check prefix retention - example pseudo-request
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-opt-13b-q8", "input":"Hello, this is a long prefix...", "max_new_tokens":5}'
```
and then explain expected behavior vs truncated scenario.

Marco L: Pushed quick patch: changed link to https://docs.redwood.ai/qprofiles/v2 and added `# dtype: float32` comment to the snippet. Fixed test path. PR description updated with DOCS-587. 

docs-bot: PR #1247 — docs-ci succeeded. 4 checks passed.

Priya S: Awesome — can someone add the migration guide section? Jay, if you can drop the KV-prefetch + truncation blurb I can edit for tone and then we merge.

Jay O: I'll push a draft to the migration guide branch in ~30m. Will include both fp32 and q8 snippets and the diagnostic curl.

Ana K: After merge, can we add a short note in the release notes under "Docs" so customer-facing folks know about the new guidance? I'll handle that.

Priya S: Perfect — thanks all. Closing loop: once PR merges, update the docs index redirect (so old qprofile link still resolves) and add a small anchor to the migration guide.

Marco L: Merged. Closing branch.

docs-bot: PR #1247 merged by Marco L — docs site redeploy queued.

Priya S: Verified live — link resolves, quickstart snippet shows `dtype` comment, migration guide section is up. Marking DOCS-587 as done. :tada:
